prompt:
Find detection gaps: missing monitors, runbooks, CMDB links, or alerts that would have caught this earlier.
Each gap MUST include a non-empty evidence string grounded in this incident. No evidence = do not include it.
Do not repeat existing_gaps. Do not invent tools we do not have.
suggested_monitoring_or_runbook_change must be concrete.
confidence is required (0 to 1) for the batch.

gaps.gap_description: Service vikrantsingh.fyi has no CMDB CI, dependencies, or routing metadata, so ownership and blast radius cannot be resolved during triage.
gaps.evidence: cmdb_snapshot.primary_ci_id is null, matched/dependencies/used_by are empty, affected_ci_ids is empty, unknown_service is "vikrantsingh.fyi", and routing_hint is null.
gaps.suggested_monitoring_or_runbook_change: Create a CMDB CI for vikrantsingh.fyi (or map the alias to an existing CI), attach owner/team and dependency links, and set a routing_hint so triage does not land on unknown_service.

gaps.gap_description: No runbook or alert-suppression path for explicitly labeled manual-test / non-outage scheduled-job failures, so test noise still opens a full triage incident.
gaps.evidence: title is "manual test: Grok key test: scheduled job failed 2 runs in a row: http 503 (github) (not a real outage)"; triage.category is "Test/False Positive"; source is "alert"; state is TRIAGING with priority Low.
gaps.suggested_monitoring_or_runbook_change: Add an intake runbook rule: if title/body contains "manual test" or "not a real outage", auto-tag Test/False Positive, suppress paging, and route to a low-priority reliability queue without full incident workflow.

gaps.gap_description: Missing dedicated monitor/runbook linkage for repeated scheduled-job HTTP 503s against GitHub that would classify external dependency failure vs internal regression before human triage.
gaps.evidence: title reports "scheduled job failed 2 runs in a row: http 503 (github)"; affected_services lists only "vikrantsingh.fyi"; triage.reasoning cites GitHub HTTP 503 and Reliability routing with no dependency CI matches.
gaps.suggested_monitoring_or_runbook_change: Add a scheduled-job failure monitor that keys on consecutive run failures and HTTP 503 from github.com, annotates external-dependency, and links a short runbook step to check GitHub status before opening a service incident.
